item.title: Apixaban linked to lower stroke and bleeding rates than warfarin in AF and advanced CKD
item.description: In patients with atrial fibrillation and advanced chronic kidney disease not on dialysis, apixaban was associated with significantly lower rates of ischemic stroke and bleeding compared with warfarin.

item.title: Coroner details infant deaths in Pennsylvania measles outbreak
item.description: The two measles-related deaths in Pennsylvania last month involved infants, and the virus itself caused one of the deaths, a coroner confirmed.

item.title: Once-monthly PrEP drug could be produced for $3 a year
item.description: Merck's current global access agreement for its once-monthly alimatravir would exclude countries with more than 230,000 new HIV infections annually.

item.title: Feature interference and the brain's difficulty with uncertain tasks
item.description: Multitasking is often seen as essential in modern life, but managing multiple chat windows, an email inbox and other demands can overwhelm the brain.
